text:
sophia_partnerships: quick sync — we need a 10m huddle to kick off the cloud listing setup for the new publisher bundle. top items: publisher portal access (role ARNs), KMS key policy, trial SKU naming convention, and the EULA telemetry clause. can we do 11:30am PT?

dylan_sales: 11:30 works for me. i'll bring the marketplace contact. do we have a preferred naming pattern for trial SKUs?

anya_legal: i can join for 10 mins. flagged: we need explicit telemetry opt-out text in the EULA for gcp marketplace (their reviewers flagged it last time). also verify data residency stanza for eu customers.

raj_eng: fyi, publisher portal needs a cross-account role with limited permissions. sample trust policy i'll paste below — it's minimal but should unblock portal creds:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```

raj_eng: also recommend the following permissions scope for the role: `s3:GetObject`, `s3:ListBucket` on the asset bucket, and `kms:Decrypt` for manifest validation. we can narrow further if legal wants.

marketplace_onboard_bot: reminder: upload your publisher manifest to s3://redwood-marketplace-manifests/<pub-id>/ by EOD for automated validation. See: https://internal.docs/marketplace/manifest-spec

sophia_partnerships: agenda for the quick call: 1) confirm role ARN & who owns creation, 2) KMS key policy owner + rotation timing, 3) final trial SKU strings (we prefer `redwood-pro-trial-30d` pattern but open), 4) EULA telemetry phrasing, 5) next artifacts to hand off to marketplace ops.

dylan_sales: i'll open a workspace ticket with the marketplace rep and drop the rep's contact in the thread before the call. i'll also attach last listing's manifest for reference.

anya_legal: sample EULA wording to consider (draft): "Customers may opt out of anonymized usage telemetry; telemetry is used solely for product quality and billing validation and will not be linked to personal identifiers." will add a short clause about eu data residency.

raj_eng: if we standardize on `redwood-<tier>-trial-<days>` we can map it to analytics and billing easily. suggest `redwood-startup-trial-30d` and `redwood-pro-trial-30d`.

sophia_partnerships: perfect. i'll send a calendar invite for 11:30 PT and attach the manifest + draft EULA. meeting will be 15 min in case we need follow-ups. thanks all :thumbsup:

marketplace_onboard_bot: validation job queued for s3://redwood-marketplace-manifests/PRJ-889/manifest.yaml — status: pending

dylan_sales: noted — i'll wait to share the marketplace rep until manifest passes initial validation.

anya_legal: if manifest references telemetry endpoints, flag them now so we can review the wording before we submit.

raj_eng: i'll scrub endpoints and replace with placeholders in the manifest before upload.

sophia_partnerships: closing loop — call invite sent, artifacts in the calendar event. follow-up thread after the call with action items.
